clues.text: A disciple living in Joppa, she was always busy with works of kindness and charity.
This Joppa disciple fell sick and died, and her washed body was laid in an upper room.
After she died in Joppa, believers sent two men to nearby Lydda, urging Peter to come without delay.
Weeping widows showed Peter the tunics and other clothing this woman had made while she was still with them.
Peter sent everyone out, knelt and prayed, and she opened her eyes, saw him, and sat up.
Peter took her by the hand, helped her up, and presented her alive to the saints and widows.
When word spread all over Joppa that this woman lived again, many people believed in the Lord.
